description.value: The MacKenzie Room is a Michelin Guide-recommended casual fine dining restaurant in Vancouver's Railtown neighbourhood, open since 2015 and built from the ground up by four owner-operators without outside investors. Chef Sean Reeve steers a constantly rotating tasting menu anchored in Pacific Northwest ingredients — crudo, seasonal vegetables, fish, and local proteins — designed to be shared across multi-course formats. Critics from Condé Nast Traveller and the Michelin Guide have praised its rustic-industrial interior and culinary ambition in an under-the-radar corner of the city.
